### Borea v0.3.0-dev.2: test build for developers

This pre-release is for the Borea team and developers who want to test v0.3.0 before it is released.
It is not for users. For normal use, stay on v0.2.1.
Tell us what did not work: [Discord](https://discord.gg/nt4fK4QuTz) | [GitHub issues](https://github.com/KSAModding/Borea/issues)

#### Please test these first

- The update channel: in Settings, General, switch "Update channel for Borea" between "Stable releases" and "All releases, dev builds included". The Home banner should follow the channel within a few seconds, without a restart.
- On a Mac with a Sikarugir wrapper in `~/Applications/Sikarugir`: the game detection should find KSA there.
- On a Mac whose wrapper has no .NET runtime: the message should say in three steps how to install it, and "Check again" should start the game once it is there.

#### New since v0.3.0-dev.1

- A change of the update channel, or turning "Check for updates at start" on, checks for a new Borea release at once. The Home banner and the release notes follow the new channel without a restart.
- On a Mac, the game detection also finds Wine wrapper apps one folder below `/Applications` and `~/Applications`, such as `~/Applications/Sikarugir/KSA.app`, where Sikarugir saves its wrappers.
- The message about a missing .NET runtime in a Mac wrapper names the version in its title and gives three numbered steps: download the installer, install it through "Install Software" in the Configure window of the wrapper, and click "Check again".
- The listing editor reads the prefix of a forum thread by its id, so a prefix that the forum renames still gives the right tag.
- The text of a purple button that holds only text sits in its center.

#### Also in v0.3.0-dev.1, but not named in its notes

- Experimental: on a Mac, Borea can play the Windows build of KSA through a Wine wrapper such as Sikarugir.
- Long lists scroll smoothly, also when you scroll fast from the end back to the top.

#### How to get the next test builds

With the default update channel, "Stable releases", Borea does not tell you about pre-releases like this one.
To see them, open Settings, General, and set "Update channel for Borea" to "All releases, dev builds included".
"Check for updates at start" must be on. In v0.2.1 and v0.3.0-dev.1 the change takes effect at the next start, and from this build on it applies at once.
When v0.3.0 is released, every channel tells you about it.
